Visitor returns bare-string image replacement; mixed-case alt/src preserved (regression guard for issue #350)

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitImage(NodeContext ctx, String src, String alt, String title) {
                return new VisitResult.Custom(String.format("[image: %s -> %s]", alt, src));
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<img src=\"PhotoOne.JPG\" alt=\"Sunset Over Bay\">", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
